objects.taxonomy_description: A tall ungulate characterized by an extremely elongated neck and legs, distinct from other large mammals.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: The neck is exceptionally long relative to the body, significantly exceeding the length of the torso.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Proportions: The forelegs are notably longer than the hindlegs, creating a sloping back profile.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Structure: The head features prominent, skin-covered ossicones rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Silhouette: The animal exhibits a unique vertical stature with a high shoulder height that distinguishes it from other herbivores.
